task: Observation of Floquet-Bloch states in monolayer epitaxial graphene via tr-ARPES

method_commitments.target_observable: Energy- and momentum-resolved Floquet-Bloch states (replica bands of Dirac cone)
method_commitments.mechanism: Photon-dressed Volkov final states scattering mechanism
key_measurements: Polarization dependence of replica band intensity

derived_methods.edc_analysis: Energy distribution curves at Dirac kx
derived_methods.mdc_analysis: Momentum distribution curves at Dirac energy
derived_methods.floquet_ladder: Comparison of measured energy spacing with photon energy

related_work_references: Oka & Aoki (2009) - Floquet theory for graphene, photovoltaic Hall effect
Wang et al. (2013) - Experimental Floquet-Bloch on Bi2Se3 TI
Hübener et al. (2017) - Floquet-Weyl semimetals from 3D Dirac materials
Sentef et al. (2015) - Theory of Floquet band formation in graphene pump-probe
limitations: Single kx momentum cut only (no full 2D kx-ky mapping)
Linear polarization only (no circular polarization data)
Moderate pump intensity (no dynamical band gap resolution)
LAPE vs Floquet initial-state dressing cannot be fully disentangled
